cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(adcs_ground_station LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

option(ADCS_BUILD_TESTS "Build unit tests" ON)

# MinGW: link runtimes statically so binaries don't pick up a mismatched
# libstdc++/libgomp DLL from PATH (e.g. MATLAB's runtime folder).
if(MINGW)
  add_link_options(-static)
endif()

# --- adcs_core: C++ generated by MATLAB Coder (matlab/codegen/build_cpp.m) ---
set(ADCS_GENERATED_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/adcs_core/portable"
    CACHE PATH "Relocated output of build_cpp.m (packNGo)")
if(NOT EXISTS "${ADCS_GENERATED_DIR}/AdcsCore.cpp")
  message(FATAL_ERROR
    "Generated code not found in ${ADCS_GENERATED_DIR}.\n"
    "Run in MATLAB:  run matlab/setup.m; build_cpp")
endif()

# Refuse stale generated code: build_cpp stamps it with a hash of the MATLAB inputs
# (matlab/codegen/cpp_inputs.txt); the committed fixture carries the hash of the
# sources it was produced from. Both must match, and scripts/check_cpp_fixture.py
# (pre-commit, CI) ensures the fixture matches the current sources.
set(ADCS_FIXTURE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/data/demo_reference.txt")
set(ADCS_STAMP   "${ADCS_GENERATED_DIR}/../inputs.sha256")
file(STRINGS "${ADCS_FIXTURE}" _fixture_stamp REGEX "^inputs_sha256 " LIMIT_COUNT 1)
string(REPLACE "inputs_sha256 " "" _fixture_stamp "${_fixture_stamp}")
if(EXISTS "${ADCS_STAMP}")
  file(STRINGS "${ADCS_STAMP}" _generated_stamp LIMIT_COUNT 1)
endif()
if(NOT _generated_stamp STREQUAL _fixture_stamp)
  message(FATAL_ERROR
    "Generated C++ is stale (or the fixture is): it was not produced from the current MATLAB sources.\n"
    "Run in MATLAB:  run matlab/setup.m; build_cpp; export_cpp_fixture")
endif()

# Every generated .cpp except the sample main in examples/.
file(GLOB ADCS_CORE_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${ADCS_GENERATED_DIR}/*.cpp")
add_library(adcs_core STATIC ${ADCS_CORE_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(adcs_core PUBLIC "${ADCS_GENERATED_DIR}")

# The generated class guards its state with OpenMP nest locks (thread-safe methods).
find_package(OpenMP REQUIRED COMPONENTS CXX)
target_link_libraries(adcs_core PUBLIC OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX)

# --- adcs_windows: hand-written wrapper (TLE parsing, propagation, pass prediction) ---
add_library(adcs_windows STATIC src/window_predictor.cpp src/config.cpp)
target_include_directories(adcs_windows PUBLIC include)
target_link_libraries(adcs_windows PUBLIC adcs_core)
# Repo root, so the default data dir (<repo>/output) matches the MATLAB side.
cmake_path(GET CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR PARENT_PATH ADCS_REPO_ROOT)
target_compile_definitions(adcs_windows PRIVATE ADCS_REPO_ROOT="${ADCS_REPO_ROOT}")

# --- run_demo: C++ counterpart of matlab/scripts/run_demo.m ---
add_executable(run_demo apps/run_demo.cpp)
target_link_libraries(run_demo PRIVATE adcs_windows)

if(ADCS_BUILD_TESTS)
  enable_testing()
  add_subdirectory(tests)
endif()
